image_description: A close-up, high-angle view of a stack of ring binders lying horizontally. The spines are visible on the left, showing various colors (green, white, blue, red). The green binder in the foreground is open or has its cover lifted, revealing the metal ring mechanism and loose-leaf paper with a fingerprint-like pattern and handwritten text. The background is a textured brown surface.
